policy.comparison: current configuration cohorts; no before/after compiler claim
policy.execution: one initialized module/Realm per process; untimed prepare(input); timed public run(); checked output on every invocation; natural GC
policy.reduction: median of eight fresh-process medians; two block medians and process range; no pooled call samples
policy.memory: whole runtime-child peak RSS, not live JavaScript heap; preparation RSS separate

scriptc.reason: Scriptc WASI _start has no compatible retained-module prepare/run ABI

policy.caveats: descriptive same-host observations; not conformance, statistical confidence or universal application performance

ir_source_qualification.note: Reused passing IR binary and complete original execution receipts; exact IR/front-end Git trees and overlay inputs are unchanged. Original source and executable identities remain recorded.

coverage.limits: No full workspace CI or pinned Test262 rerun. Focused scopes may overlap broader scopes and must not be summed. All Engine scopes ran on identical current product inputs with preserved source qualification; four preexisting AOT library failures remain failures.
coverage.source_guards_qualification: All 380 source-only guards pass on the frozen candidate.

baseline.preservation: Hash-verified prior source reconstruction in the prior published archive; old histories are not nested.

caveats: Same exact module bytes and seed schedule; each actor includes its public call bridge and print conversion/capture. Empty control is shown without subtraction.
Preparation, source/native compilation, module initialization and result validation are outside call timing. Preparation can still affect later natural GC, feedback and JIT invalidation.
Three warmups and seven samples describe this schedule; V8 is allowed normal JIT/GC and is not claimed to have reached optimized steady state.
Operations count logical source work, not retired lookups or allocations; optimizations and folding are allowed.
Shallow/deep also vary padding captures/arithmetic. Deep/bound-deep is the closer resolution contrast; bound aliases may fold. Getter row includes live getter calls and counter increments.
Branch cases vary control-flow, static/dynamic step keys and call-site polymorphism. Native image growth is measured; individual stack frame sizes and probe cost are not isolated.
Observed arguments adds arguments property reads; differences are not allocations. Property mutation occurs in preparation; no compact/dictionary representation is asserted.
Native serialized P image includes metadata and data; portable Wasm P is separate. Child peak RSS includes host, code and process history, not just guest heap.
Scriptc has no compatible retained-module prepare/run ABI in this workflow, so its fresh WASI entry is not substituted.
These focused programs complement the separate RSC and fresh-entry kernel cohorts; no aggregate workload score or current-source requalification of those cohorts is implied.
implementation: Pure repeating predicate periods of at most 64 entries use one I64 bitset; larger periods retain NumberBits storage and the original exact predicate semantics.
Read-only packed-Array own-descriptor probes preserve current backing storage, holes and live descriptor values; mutations retain the required materialization path.
The existing completed-prefix copy and fallback behavior remains; Runtime ABI51 and Fast/Speed native policies are unchanged.
